name: Sandwalker (CR 14)
body:
SANDWALKER
CR 14

XP 38,400
Human slayer 15
CG Medium humanoid (human)
Init +9; Senses Perception +23

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 15, flat-footed 15 (+4 armor, +5 Dex, +4 dodge, +1 shield)
hp 147 (15d10+60)
Fort +13, Ref +16, Will +7
Defensive Abilities evasion, fortification 25%

OFFENSE

Speed 35 ft.
Melee +1 undead–bane rapier +22/+17/+12 (1d6+2/15–20 plus 2d6 vs. undead) or +1 undead–bane rapier +20/+15/+10 (1d6+2/15–20 plus 2d6 vs. undead), +1 guardian dagger +19/+14 (1d4+1/19–20)
Special Attacks quarry, slayer’s advance 1/day, sneak attack +5d6, studied target +4 (4th, swift action)

TACTICS

During Combat When facing an opponent that is difficult to strike, the slayer feints their studied target to make sneak attacks and uses the dagger’s guardian ability to improve their saves.

Base Statistics Without Combat Expertise, studied target, and the guardian ability, the slayer has the following stats: AC 20, touch 15, flat-footed 15 (+4 armor, +5 Dex, +1 shield); Fort +12, Ref +15, Will +6; Skills Bluff +17, Intimidate +17, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +20, Perception +23, Sense Motive +18, Stealth +23, Survival +18.

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 20, Con 14, Int 14, Wis 10, Cha 8
Base Atk +15; CMB +16; CMD 31
Feats Combat Expertise, Critical Focus, Fast Learner, Fleet, Improved Critical (rapier), Improved Feint, Improved Initiative, Improved Two-Weapon Fighting, Toughness, Two-Weapon Defense, Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (rapier)
Skills Acrobatics +23, Bluff +21, Disable Device +12, Escape Artist +20, Heal +20, Intimidate +21, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +24, Perception +27, Sense Motive +22, Stealth +27, Survival +22
Languages Aklo, Common, Ignan
SQ combat style (two-weapon combat), slayer talents (evasion, fast stealth, finesse rogue, ranger combat style [3], surprise attacks), stalker, swift tracker, track +7
Gear +1 bitter light fortification studded leather, +1 guardian dagger, +1 undeadbane rapier, belt of incredible Dexterity +2, boots of vaulting, cloak of resistance +1, eyes of the eagle, ring of maniacal devices, vest of surgery, masterwork thieves’ tools, 103 gp

ABOUT

The sandwalker hunts evil in ancient tombs, destroying it wherever it is found.
